shadows.name: drawer

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: A luminous ocean-teal action for the page's strongest command.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 40px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid var(--ocean-teal, #70c9d2); border-radius: 6px; color: #071417; background: var(--ocean-teal, #70c9d2); font: 750 11px/1.2 Manrope, sans-serif; transition: background .18s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--ocean-teal-light, #9ae0e5); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f4fbf8; outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px var(--ocean-teal, #70c9d2); }

components.name: Utility Button
components.description: Compact evidence controls with a 44px mobile target.
components.css: .ds-button-utility { min-height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #3a5c62); border-radius: 6px; color: var(--body, #c0cfcc); background: #102329; font: 750 11px/1.2 Manrope, sans-serif; transition: border-color .18s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), color .18s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), background .18s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-button-utility:hover { border-color: #5b9296; color: #9ae0e5; background: #17383d; } .ds-button-utility:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f4fbf8; outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px var(--ocean-teal, #70c9d2); } @media (max-width: 899px) { .ds-button-utility { min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px; } }

components.name: Evidence Card
components.description: A ruled paper module for charts and analytical evidence.
components.html:
Pipeline contribution

Direct units, interpretation, caveat, and data alternative stay together.
components.css: .ds-evidence-card { padding: 14px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #3a5c62); border-radius: 10px; color: var(--ink, #edf7f4); background: #102329; transition: border-color .18s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), box-shadow .18s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-evidence-card h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; font: 650 17px/1.16 Newsreader, Georgia, serif; letter-spacing: -.012em; } .ds-evidence-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--body, #c0cfcc); font: 400 12px/1.55 Manrope, sans-serif; } .ds-evidence-card:hover { border-color: #6d9da0; box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.24); }

components.name: Confidence Chip
components.description: A textual confidence marker whose meaning survives without color.
components.css: .ds-confidence-chip { display: inline-flex; min-height: 23px; align-items: center; padding: 0 7px; border: 1px solid #875c45; border-radius: 5px; color: #f3bd98; background: #3a2a24; font: 850 9px/1 Manrope, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .02em; }

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: A deep-petrol rail destination with the signature copper trace.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { position: relative; display: flex; min-height: 36px; align-items: center; padding: 0 10px 0 14px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; color: #c4d8d6; background: #061316; font: 520 12px/1.2 Manrope, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-item:hover { border-color: #3b6468; color: #f4fbf8; background: #18373d; } .ds-nav-item-active { border-color: #5a888b; color: #f4fbf8; background: #1d4950; } .ds-nav-item-active::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 8px auto 8px 0; width: 2px; background: #efad79; } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #f4fbf8; outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px var(--ocean-teal, #70c9d2); }

components.name: Data Table
components.description: A compact, tabular evidence surface with night-mineral row states.
components.css: .ds-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; color: #c0cfcc; background: #102329; font: 400 12px/1.4 Manrope, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-table th, .ds-table td { padding: 9px 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid #28464c; text-align: left; } .ds-table th { color: #c8dbd8; background: #1b383d; font-size: 10px; } .ds-table tbody tr:nth-child(even) { background: #142a2f; } .ds-table tbody tr:hover { background: #1b3d42; }

narrative.overview: The interface feels like an operator's evidence desk after hours: deep petrol framing, blue-black mineral surfaces, ruled modules, luminous ocean-teal signals, and warm copper or terracotta only where interpretation demands attention. It is dark-first for low ambient light, dense but not cramped, editorial but not theatrical, and designed to make analytical confidence visible. The page is a presentation layer over a validated schema-v2 data contract. Preserve the source metrics, caveats, required section order, chart/table parity, export paths, presentation and print modes, and the /full-analysis archive. Visual changes must not silently recalculate, omit, or reframe the evidence.
keyCharacteristics: Decision first; evidence, implication, and action remain traceable.
Petrol command rail, mineral canvas, night-paper modules, and fine rules.
Newsreader gives conclusions authority; Manrope keeps controls and data legible.
Color carries semantic meaning and is reinforced by labels, patterns, or copy.

rules.name: The Accountable Color Rule
rules.body: A semantic color keeps the same meaning across KPIs, charts, caveats, and actions; labels and patterns preserve that meaning without color.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Newsreader speaks for interpretation; Manrope speaks for operation and evidence. Do not introduce a third display or UI family.

rules.name: The Content-Preservation Rule
rules.body: Responsive and presentation modes may reflow or focus the evidence, but must retain required sections, labels, denominators, accessible summaries, table/download alternatives, and the original analytical order.

rules.name: The Ruled-First Rule
rules.body: Prefer a one-pixel mineral border or tonal step before adding elevation.

dos: **Do** lead with the operating decision, then show evidence, limitations, and the measurable action.
**Do** keep chart summaries, caveats, data tables, downloads, print output, and schema validation intact.
**Do** use rules and mineral tonal layers as the primary composition system.
**Do** retain 44px mobile controls and visible keyboard focus.
donts: **Don't** replace the signal atlas with a generic blue KPI wall, glassmorphism, gradients, or decorative 3D.
**Don't** use warm colors ornamentally or let color become the only carrier of meaning.
**Don't** hide analytical sections, change denominators, or overstate observational evidence as causal.
**Don't** preload the chart module or let chart code block the decision-first shell.
